priorityList: Apply Arcane Intellect and pre-cast Blizzard and Glacial Spike before combat begins.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial cooldowns alongside Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Blizzard immediately whenever the Freezing Rain buff is active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown as your highest priority resource generator.
Cast Glacial Spike as a high priority whenever available.
Use Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active or if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active (and Thermal Void is not active) or whenever the spell is off cooldown.
Cast Ray of Frost if you do not have a Frostfire Empowerment proc active.
Cast Blizzard for 3 or more targets if Frozen Orb is on cooldown.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and procs.
When moving, use Blink/Shimmer to maintain casting, or use Blizzard (with Freezing Rain) and Ice Lance if forced to move.
